reviews.author: Diana M. LeBron
reviews.text: Carlos, Fernando (Lead Mechanic) and Oscar are the BEST MECHANICS I have ever encountered in Carteret. They are experts and extremely knowledgeable in their field. I have taken my car to be serviced by them many times and I am completely satisfied. Finding a mechanic who is compassionate, sensitive to one's situation is very hard to find. For a lot of mechanics, it is a job. Not for them. If you received a quote from another mechanic, bring your car to them to receive a second opinion. They will find the real issue and show you how you were being cheated by another mechanic. It is mind boggling how some mechanics can be unethical and steal from you. You will get an accurate cost of the labor and repair. The prices here are very budget friendly, competitive, and not intimidating. They are very passionate, transparent and 100% GUARANTEE THEIR WORK! They speak English and Spanish - a bonus. I highly recommend them.

reviews.text: I was helped by Gil. He was extremely professional and thorough. He took the time to explain to me and show me what the noise was that I was hearing with my vehicle. I definitely found my new mechanic and will not go anywhere else from here on out. We need more honest mechanics like Gil. Thanks again!

I will have all of my vehicles serviced by Gill and NJ Punjab Auto Repair. They have a lifelong customer in me.

reviews.text: I have taken my daughter's car to them on several occasions. Oscar is a great mechanic. Oscar and the owner kept me informed through the whole process. reviews.author: Corey Williams
reviews.text: Avoid this shop at all costs. My experience was beyond frustrating, it felt like being trapped in a cycle of deception and neglect. From day one, the place was completely disorganized and unprofessional. Communication was nearly impossible, as the mechanics could barely explain anything clearly, leaving me confused and uneasy about what was happening to my car. For three full weeks, my vehicle just sat there with no real progress. Every time I asked for answers, I was given a different story, three completely conflicting explanations, none backed by any actual diagnostic report or written proof. It felt like they were stalling, hoping I’d just go along with whatever they said. The owner, Syed, was never available, completely absent the entire time. I was repeatedly told he would call me back, yet not once did he follow through. Calls went unanswered, messages ignored. It felt like I was being deliberately avoided. What made things worse was the complete lack of accountability. When I finally had enough and decided to remove my car, they refused to provide any documentation showing it had even been there for three weeks with no work done. That alone raised serious red flags. The most alarming moment was when they casually suggested I replace the engine in my 2014 Mercedes E350, with only 90,000 miles, with a used engine. That recommendation made no sense and confirmed my suspicion that something wasn’t right. Overall, the entire experience felt shady, misleading, and stressful. I walked away feeling like I had narrowly avoided being taken advantage of. Save yourself the time, money, and headache, stay far away from this place. P.S I’m still waiting to speak with Syed and the young staff member who scanned my vehicle.

reviews.author: Iroel De la Paz
reviews.text: The worst of the worst. I went to get my car's air conditioning fixed and they couldn't fix it. They charged me $200 for a service that never worked. I recommend everyone avoid going there if you don't want to waste your money. When I went to Pep Boy's, they fixed it in half an hour.
